cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: More Official Than You
cards.instruction: Turn every suggestion into a contest over whose method, title, precedent, or paperwork is more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your picnic rota is useful. Mine has committee approval.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine got everyone to bring sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Mine establishes who was entitled to request those sandwiches.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then approve mine. We've already started eating.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. I'll attach it as an appendix to mine, so lunch has a legitimate basis.

mechanism: A supervises how a practical lunch rota is annexed to A's approved one, winning the legitimacy contest even while using B's successful work.
confusable: D180 requests the normal route; D187 makes the comparison between A's and B's authority the game.
comparison: Incorporating a colleague's useful plan differs from rejecting a founder's personal exception.
seedUse: Keep B's lunch-already-started solution; make annexing an actual instruction rather than explanatory ending.
